properties.short_description: Tesla is a multinational company specializing in electric vehicles, solar energy products, and integrated renewable energy solutions.
Apple Inc is a global technology company known for its innovative products like iPhone, iPad, Mac, and services including software updates and device trade-in programs.
GoPro is a technology brand known for its action cameras and related accessories used for capturing immersive photos and videos in extreme conditions.
Automobili Lamborghini is an Italian luxury sports car manufacturer known for high-performance supercars like the Huracán, Aventador, and Urus SUV.
Porsche is a German automotive brand known for manufacturing high-performance sports cars, SUVs, and electric vehicles, with a strong presence in Indonesia.
Aston Martin is a globally recognized British brand known for ultra-luxury, high-performance sports cars and grand tourers, symbolizing exclusivity, elegance, and innovation.
Mercedes-Benz is a global luxury automotive brand known for manufacturing premium cars, SUVs, and performance vehicles.
Formula One (F1) is the highest class of international open-wheel single-seater auto racing, featuring the fastest cars and top drivers worldwide.
Jeep is a brand of SUVs, 4x4 models, and electric vehicles known for rugged off-road capability and hybrid technology.
Audi is a premium automotive brand known for luxury vehicles including SUVs, sedans, electric vehicles, and high-performance models like the RS range.
BMW is a German luxury automobile brand known for its high-performance cars, digital products, and connected services.
Red Bull is a global brand known for its energy drinks, including original, sugar-free, zero-calorie, and flavored editions, and its involvement in sports and entertainment events.
Bugatti is a luxury automotive brand known for producing hyper sports cars that combine timeless elegance with extreme speed and advanced engineering.
Volkswagen is a global automotive brand known for manufacturing cars and SUVs, including popular models like the Golf GTI and Atlas.
Bentley Motors is a luxury automobile manufacturer known for handcrafted cars combining performance, comfort, and exquisite materials.
Jaguar is a luxury automotive brand known for high-performance vehicles including SUVs and sports cars.
Maserati is an Italian luxury automotive brand known for high-performance sports cars, SUVs, and elegant design.
Rolls-Royce Motor Cars is a luxury automobile manufacturer known for bespoke, high-end vehicles like the Phantom and Spectre super coupé.
British luxury automotive manufacturer specializing in high-performance supercars and racing technology.
Land Rover is a British brand known for luxury SUVs and 4x4 vehicles, including the Range Rover and Defender models.
